analysis.title: Neon Mechanical Portal Interface
analysis.notes: A large metallic oval mechanism dominates the composition, combining realistic industrial detailing with glowing orange rings and blue graphic accents. Sparse interface controls, directional arrows, and oversized sans-serif typography create a cinematic technology landing page with strong depth and motion.
analysis.heroPrompt: Create a cinematic hero visual of a massive futuristic mechanical oval portal centered slightly left on a nearly black blue background. Use layered gunmetal armor, exposed bolts, precision machinery, and concentric inner rings emitting a vivid amber-orange glow. Add restrained electric-blue geometric accents behind the structure, subtle atmospheric shadows, directional chevrons, tiny interface markers, and a thin horizontal progress line. High-detail industrial rendering, dramatic contrast, clean negative space on the right for typography, premium technology editorial art direction, no logos, no brand marks, no readable text.
